blocks.text: Origin / creation. The Final Era Zero Assembly authorized specialists to compare artifacts, institutions, ecologies, decisions, and developmental consequences against the archive and predictive models.
Identity / human status. Artificial analysts and audit institutions.
Importance. They detected Long-Tail Loss, the Paradox of Abundance, and structural recurrence beneath surface variation.
Decline or transformation. Audit authority became entangled with funding, governance, and certification. Measures intended to diagnose closure became incentives that communities learned to perform.

Final status / surviving function. Absorbed into the Bureaucracy of Num. Their reliable diagnosis remains valuable; their institutional fate demonstrates how a measure can reshape and damage what it measures.
